days.title: 大岭角 – 门滩
days.morning: Catch the earliest mainland sunrise at Mui Dien and climb Dai Lanh lighthouse.
days.afternoon: Swim at Bai Mon and visit O Loan lagoon.
days.evening: Tuna eyes and Nhan Tower by night.

days.title: 盘石滩 – 春台
days.morning: Explore Ganh Da Dia and Mang Lang church.
days.afternoon: Boat on Xuan Dai Bay and Do Do village (from the film "Mat Biec").
days.evening: Blood cockles from O Loan lagoon.

days.title: 燕岛 – 翁岬
days.morning: Hon Yen – coral reefs revealed at low tide.
days.afternoon: Ganh Ong and Bai Xep – locations of "Yellow Flowers on the Green Grass".
days.evening: Back to Tuy Hoa for chive noodle soup.

days.title: 梅家岛
days.morning: Boat to Cu Lao Mai Nha and its crystal-clear water.
days.afternoon: Snorkel and have a seafood lunch on the island.
days.evening: Relax and stroll Tuy Hoa beach.

days.title: 同甘水坝 – 和多火车站
days.morning: The century-old Dong Cam dam and Tuy An rice fields.
days.afternoon: Hoa Da station and Chop Chai mountain.
days.evening: Buy Hoa Da rice paper as gifts.
